rules.statement: A landlord is entitled to demand the authorized rent from a tenant after the original contract has terminated, provided that such increase in rent is legally permissible.
rules.supporting_quote: Once the contractual tenancy is at an end and the tenant remains in possession by virtue of the statute, the rent of the house is regulated by the statute and is not affected by terms or conditions or estoppels. On giving proper notice the landlord can raise the rent to the full amount permitted by the statute.
